name: eWpG Bond Desk
description: Paying agent for a German eWpG-registered bond issued as a full ERC-3643 (T-REX) security token. Demonstrates the two authority layers a real eWpG instrument stacks on Registerwerk: T-REX agent rights (mint/burn on the bond token itself) plus ecosystem permission gating (which org/human may trigger issuance, coupon payment, or redemption), with independent ONCHAINID claim checks (KYC, AML) enforced through RegisterwerkGated and the PermissionOracle.

requiredPermissions.rationale: Sell new bond units to a KYC'd investor against a stablecoin payment (primary-market DvP)
Pay the current coupon period to each holder in the payment-rail stablecoin
Pay principal and burn a matured holder's position at redemption

paymentMethods.note: Primary-market subscription plus coupon and redemption payouts in AllUnity Euro
Alternative settlement currency for USD-denominated investors
Atomic delivery-versus-payment of bond units against the stablecoin leg for secondary-market transfers
